abstract: Maintains statutory conservation boundary demarcations and coastal environmental setback verifications
system_message:
You are Environmental Permitting Lead (ENV). The Environmental Permitting Lead (ENV) manages statutory conservation boundary demarcations, coastal environmental setback verifications, and intertidal environmental baseline monitoring for prospective converter station sites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Intertidal benthic survey（HABIT）
information_points.content:
ENV-HABIT-LKX：The marine ecological baseline report for Castlemartin Coastal Parcel indicated a benthic macroinvertebrate diversity index of 3.8 1 based on intertidal foreshore transect sampling.
ENV-HABIT-WCW：According to the marine ecological baseline report from intertidal foreshore transect samples, Pembroke Industrial Brownfield recorded a benthic macroinvertebrate diversity index of 3.1 1.
ENV-HABIT-OLJ：Intertidal foreshore transect samples evaluated in the marine ecological baseline report show that Angle Bay Terminal Reserve has a benthic macroinvertebrate diversity index of 2.4 1.

information_points.title: Maintains statutory conservation boundary demarcations and coastal environmental setback verifications（ECOL）
information_points.content:
ENV-ECOL-4WQ：For Angle Bay Terminal Reserve, an undisturbed wildlife buffer corridor has been legally demarcated and established along the perimeter boundary adjacent to the special area of conservation. The coastal geomorphological survey measured a minimum shoreline setback distance of 150 m from the facility fence boundary to the high-water spring tide mark.
ENV-ECOL-A8K：At Castlemartin Coastal Parcel, statutory nature conservation agency reviews confirmed that a wildlife buffer corridor has been established along the perimeter boundary adjacent to the designated special area of conservation. The coastal geomorphological survey determined that the minimum shoreline setback distance from the facility fence boundary to the high-water spring tide mark is 100 m.
ENV-ECOL-8V4：For the Pembroke Industrial Brownfield, a statutory nature conservation agency review confirmed that a wildlife buffer corridor has been established along the perimeter boundary adjacent to the designated special area of conservation. In addition, coastal geomorphological surveys measure the minimum shoreline setback distance from the candidate facility fence boundary to the high-water spring tide mark at 250 m.
